edges.notes: axios.post(`${getBaseUrl()}/api/auth/admin`). getBaseUrl() (frontend/src/utils/baseURL.ts) returns the literal http://localhost:5000 = backend/index.js's PORT fallback 5000 (backend/.env.example sets PORT=''). backend/index.js mounts userRoutes at /api/auth; router.post("/admin")
axios.get(`${getBaseUrl()}/api/admin`) in a useEffect; base http://localhost:5000. backend/index.js mounts adminRoutes (src/stats/admin.stats.js) at /api/admin; router.get("/")
axios.put(`${getBaseUrl()}/api/books/edit/${id}`); base http://localhost:5000. bookRoutes mounted at /api/books; router.put("/edit/:id", verifyAdminToken, UpdateBook)

RTK Query endpoint fetchAllBooks: builder.query, query: () => "/" (a string, so GET). baseQuery = fetchBaseQuery({ baseUrl: `${getBaseUrl()}/api/books` }) = http://localhost:5000/api/books; joined with "/" it ends in a slash, which Express's non-strict routing matches to router.get("/") under the /api/books mount
RTK Query endpoint fetchBookById: query: (id) => `/${id}` (string, GET) under baseUrl .../api/books; router.get("/:id"), the only GET besides "/"
RTK Query endpoint addBook: builder.mutation, { url: `/create-book`, method: "POST" } under baseUrl .../api/books; router.post("/create-book", verifyAdminToken, postABook)
RTK Query endpoint updateBook: { url: `/edit/${id}`, method: "PUT" } under baseUrl .../api/books; router.put("/edit/:id")
RTK Query endpoint deleteBook: { url: `/${id}`, method: "DELETE" } under baseUrl .../api/books; router.delete("/:id")

RTK Query endpoint createOrder, written (builder.mutation) ({ … }): { url: "/", method: "POST" }; inline baseQuery fetchBaseQuery({ baseUrl: `${getBaseUrl()}/api/orders` }) = http://localhost:5000/api/orders. orderRoutes mounted at /api/orders; router.post("/") (trailing slash matched, non-strict routing)
RTK Query endpoint getOrderByEmail, written (builder.query) ({ … }): { url: `/email/${email}` } with no method, so GET; router.get("/email/:email") under /api/orders
